title: Cover the Cargo intermediate build directory in disk-space preflight
outcome: The launcher accounts for CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR, including path templates and Windows casing, or explicitly documents it as an unchecked location requiring coordinator capacity planning.
acceptance: The supported Cargo build-directory contract is confirmed from primary documentation and the project's toolchain.
The disk-space preflight checks the effective intermediate-output filesystem, or docs/test.md explicitly names the unchecked selector and required planning.
Any implementation has focused tests for alternate output paths and preserves the full-only refusal policy.
